message.reasoning_content:
We need to identify crimes based on facts: Zhang fabricated loan, used forged property certificates as collateral, signed loan contract, obtained 20,000 RMB from victim. This is fraud (诈骗罪) using false documents, also possibly "伪造、变造国家机关公文、证件、印章罪"? He forged property certificates, but used them to defraud. The crime of "诈骗罪" (fraud) covers obtaining money by false pretenses. Also "伪造、变造金融票据罪"? Not. The forged documents are property rights certificates, not official documents? They are "房屋所有权证", "国有土地使用证", "契证". These are official certificates, forging them is a crime: "伪造、变造国家机关公文、证件、印章罪". However the fact says he used forged documents as collateral. The primary crime is fraud. The forging itself is also a crime. Chinese criminal law: Article 266 (伪造、变造国家机关公文、证件、印章罪) includes forging certificates of property rights? Those are issued by real estate registration authorities, considered state-issued certificates. So yes.

Thus list: 诈骗罪; 伪造、变造国家机关公文、证件、印章罪.
